svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make 2, identical; turn one over for the right. Plate 34 x 130 mm, 80 mm over the tabs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An upper part and a 30 mm wide leg that hangs 48 mm below it at the front.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Back edge: two tabs and one T-slot into the front knuckle post plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: T-slot: 9 mm wide, 23 deep, with a 13.6 x 8.4 mm window 10 mm in for the nut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the fin stands upright, fore and aft, under the front of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: knuckle post; its leg's back edge is 32 mm ahead of the kingpin axis.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: At full lock (40 deg at the inner wheel) the steering arm clamp

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate's front inboard corner meets the leg's back edge. The load

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: then runs along the fin, in its own plane.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check before the first ride: turn to full lock each way; each clamp

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate meets its stop, and the tyres clear the box and the posts.
